en.title: Count Substrings Made of Two Equal-Length Binary Blocks
en.description:
Count the contiguous substrings of the form 0^k1^k or 1^k0^k with k≥1. Substrings are counted by their start and end indices, so repeated content is counted separately; this is not every substring with equal numbers of 0s and 1s.

The input/output format was compiled by this site.
en.input: One line containing a non-empty binary string. The original text gives no numeric bounds; on this site the length is 1..200000.
en.output: Output the number of qualifying substrings.
hints: Split the string into runs of identical consecutive characters; two adjacent runs of lengths a,b contribute min(a,b).
